Inhale deeply to expand the ribcage and lift the shoulder blades, then exhale slowly to lower the torso and compress the frame. Maintain a steady, rhythmic cadence until settling firmly into the original stance. Mouth stays closed the whole time: jaw, snout and tusks do not move. Only the chest and back rise and fall slightly. Hooves stay planted, legs and tail barely move, static camera, no zoom.

Standing ready to fight: a deep inhale, the chest expands and the body lifts slightly, then exhales and the body lowers. The smoke tip of the tail ripples gently. The eyes blink once. Mouth closed the whole time, the horns do not move. All four feet stay planted, ends exactly on the start pose, static camera, no zoom.
